611637.title: Intermediate Units
611637.description:
Pennsylvania's 29 Intermediate Units are regional education service agencies charged with providing programs and services to public, private and non-public (religious) schools.

Intermediate Units serve schools in geographic areas ranging in size from a single school district located in one city to serving schools across six counties. Some Intermediate Units also provide special services to schools throughout the Commonwealth.

All Intermediate Units provide curriculum and instructional support, professional development, technology services and operate educational programs such as special and alternative education on a regional basis.

Intermediate Units are governed by boards of directors composed of school board members from member school districts. Each Intermediate Unit is led by an Executive Director. Intermediate Units are supported by member school districts, state funds and state and federal grants.

The District extends to the southern border of Armstrong County, the northern border of Westmoreland County and western border of Indiana County. Five municipalities from two counties, Armstrong and Indiana, comprise the District -- Apollo Borough, Jacksonville/Blacklick Township, Kiskiminetas Township, North Apollo Borough and Young Township. Site provides news, information, contacts and overviews of individual schools.

links.title: Lakeland School District
links.description: (Jermyn) K-12 Lackawanna County district serving students in the Boroughs of Jermyn and Mayfield and the Townships of Carbondale, Greenfield, and Scott. Site provides mission statement, district map, cafeteria menus, policies, calendar, student handbook, school links, and contact information.

links.title: Blairsville-Saltsburg School District
links.description: (Blairsville) K-12 district serving students in portions of two counties. In Indiana County the district serves the Boroughs of Blairsville and Saltsburg and Black Lick Township, Burrell Township and Conemaugh Township. In Westmoreland County it covers Loyalhanna Township. Site provides mission statement, calendar, board policies and minutes, cafeteria menu, district news, and school sites.

links.title: Ligonier Valley School District
links.description: (Ligonier) K-12 Westmoreland County district serving students in the boroughs of Ligonier and Laurel Mountain, Bolivar, Seward, New Florence, Bolivar, as well as the townships of St. Clair and Ligonier, and Fairfield. Site offers policies, cafeteria menus, calendar, athletic schedules, employment opportunities, and school links.

links.title: Millcreek Township School District
links.description: (Erie) K-12 district serving students in Millcreek Township in Erie County. Site provides calendar, district news, programs, school links, departments, employment opportunities, and contact information.

links.title: Eastern Lancaster County School District
links.description: (New Holland) K-12 Lancaster County district serving students in the Boroughs of New Holland and Terre Hill as well as Brecknock Township, Caernarvon Township, Earl Township, East Earl Township. Site features calendar, cafeteria menus, financial reports, school links, administrative directory, and contact information.

links.title: Mars Area School District
links.description: (Mars) K-12 district serving students in Mars and Valencia Boroughs as well as Adams Township and Middlesex Township in Butler County. Site features lunch menus, calendar, district reports, athletic schedules, school links, and contact information.

links.title: Albert Gallatin Area School District
links.description: (Uniontown) K-12 district in Fayettte County, serving students in the boroughs of Masontown, Fairchance, Point Marion, and Smithfield. It also serves German, Springhill, Georges, and Nicholson townships. Includes calendar, mission statement, board minutes, cafeteria menus, administrative directory, school sites, and contact information.

links.title: Harbor Creek School District
links.description: (Harborcreek) K-12 district serving students in Harborcreek Township in Erie County. Site includes district news, calendar, curriculum, staff directory, employment opportunities, health bulletins, news, and school links.

links.title: Bethlehem-Center School District
links.description: (Fredericktown) K-12 Washington County district serving students in the Boroughs of Beallsville, Centerville, Deemston and Marianna and East Bethlehem Township and West Bethlehem Township. Site has district news, administration contact information, and resources for parents, students, and faculty.

links.title: York Suburban School District
links.description: York PA. Information and upcoming events and news of what is going on in the schools.

links.title: Kiski Area School District
links.description: (Vandergrift) K-12 district serving students in portions of Armstrong and Westmoreland Counties, including Allegheny Township, Bell Township/Avonmore, East Vandergrift, Parks Township, Washington Township, and Vandergrift. Site offers newsletter, school links, annual report, district news, registration information, and upcoming events.

links.title: Hollidaysburg Area School District
links.description: (Hollidaysburg) K-12 Blair County district serving students in all of Hollidaysburg, Duncansville, Newry, and a portion of the Eldorado section in Altoona. Site provides budget, transportation information, employment opportunities, athletic schedules, calendar, and contact information.

links.title: Johnsonburg Area School District
links.description: (Johnsonburg) K-12 district serving students in the Borough of Johnsonburg as well as Jones Township and portions of Ridgway Township in Elk County. Site offers mission statement, strategic plan, district policies, current budget, school links, and contact information.

Guest units tend to be individually decorated. Rooms may not include some modern amenities such as television and telephones, and may have a shared bathroom. Usually owner-operated, with a common room or parlor, separate from the innkeeper's living quarters, where guests and operators can interact during evening and breakfast hours. Evening office closures are normal. A continental or full, hot breakfast is served and is included in the room rate."    (Quoted from the AAA. "New York TourBook". Buffalo, NY: AAA Publishing. 1999)

615925.description:
AAA classifies a Bed and Breakfast as a limited service lodging type with the following definition;

"Usually smaller establishments emphasizing a more personal relationship between operators and guests, leading to an "at home" feeling. Guest units tend to be individually decorated. Rooms may not include some modern amenities such as television and telephones, and may have a shared bathroom. Usually owner-operated, with a common room or parlor, separate from the innkeeper's living quarters, where guests and operators can interact during evening and breakfast hours. Evening office closures are normal. A continental or full, hot breakfast is served and is included in the room rate."

(Quoted from the AAA. "New York TourBook". Buffalo, NY: AAA Publishing. 1999)

616143.title: Bed and Breakfast
616143.description:
AAA classifies a Bed and Breakfast as a limited service lodging type with the following definition;

"Usually smaller establishments emphasizing a more personal relationship between operators and guests, leading to an "at home" feeling. Guest units tend to be individually decorated. Rooms may not include some modern amenities such as television and telephones, and may have a shared bathroom. Usually owner-operated, with a common room or parlor, separate from the innkeeper's living quarters, where guests and operators can interact during evening and breakfast hours. Evening office closures are normal. A continental or full, hot breakfast is served and is included in the room rate."

(Quoted from the AAA. "New York TourBook". Buffalo, NY: AAA Publishing. 1999)

612630.title: East Brandywine Township
612630.description:
Nestled in the central section Chester County are 11 square miles of rolling green acreage known as East Brandywine Township. They were once Part of Cain Township, established in 1702 as one of the first townships in modern Chester County. This large area was divided in 1739 when residents of East Cain Township petitioned for more manageable boundaries. Brandywine Township was established in 1790. Another split occurred in 1844, and East and West Brandywine Townships were born.

In the 1800s, religion was the common bond for residents of the township. Hopewell Methodist Church has been active since 1785, and a log church was built prior to 1800 in what is now the church cemetery. Stone structures replaced it in 1843 and 1867. The present gray stone chapel on Hopewell Road was built in 1913, and the sanctuary added in 1990.

The East Brandywine Baptist Church was established in 1842 in a stone structure on Route 322. Outgrown and replaced in 1968 by the more modern present church, the old building was demolished in 1991. Both Methodist and Baptist followers remain active in the township today.

612364.title: Bed and Breakfast
612364.description:
AAA classifies a Bed and Breakfast as a limited service lodging type with the following definition;

"Usually smaller establishments emphasizing a more personal relationship between operators and guests, leading to an "at home" feeling. Guest units tend to be individually decorated. Rooms may not include some modern amenities such as television and telephones, and may have a shared bathroom. Usually owner-operated, with a common room or parlor, separate from the innkeeper's living quarters, where guests and operators can interact during evening and breakfast hours. Evening office closures are normal. A continental or full, hot breakfast is served and is included in the room rate."

(Quoted from the AAA. "New York TourBook". Buffalo, NY: AAA Publishing. 1999)

Guest units tend to be individually decorated. Rooms may not include some modern amenities such as television and telephones, and may have a shared bathroom. Usually owner-operated, with a common room or parlor, separate from the innkeeper's living quarters, where guests and operators can interact during evening and breakfast hours. Guest units tend to be individually decorated. Rooms may not include some modern amenities such as television and telephones, and may have a shared bathroom. Usually owner-operated, with a common room or parlor, separate from the innkeeper's living quarters, where guests and operators can interact during evening and breakfast hours. 611920.title: Bed and Breakfast
611920.description:
AAA classifies a Bed and Breakfast as a limited service lodging type with the following definition;

"Usually smaller establishments emphasizing a more personal relationship between operators and guests, leading to an "at home" feeling. Guest units tend to be individually decorated. Rooms may not include some modern amenities such as television and telephones, and may have a shared bathroom. Usually owner-operated, with a common room or parlor, separate from the innkeeper's living quarters, where guests and operators can interact during evening and breakfast hours. Evening office closures are normal. A continental or full, hot breakfast is served and is included in the room rate."

(Quoted from the AAA. "New York TourBook". Buffalo, NY: AAA Publishing. 1999)

613128.title: Real Estate
613128.description: This category contains sites having to do with buying, selling, leasing, developing, or studying Harrisburg real estate.  Sites that do not contain proper contact information, which includes the telephone number, street, and city, risk the chance of being excluded from the directory.  Also, remember that this is a directory and not a search engine. Resubmitting your site to numerous categories will not improve your listing and will be considered SPAM.  Real Estate categories are often targets for inappropriate submissions. Many agents will attempt to list their sites multiple times, in each city in which they sell Real Estate. Also agents will sometimes add their same site, but will submit it using different URLs to many localities in order to get their site listed multiple times. Local editors are aware of these practices, and carefully look at other Real Estate categories to ensure that an agent or agency site is not listed in another locality.  Please have title in Agent Name - Company Name format if you are an agent or Company Name if your site is for an agency. Failure to do this will result in a delay in processing your request for addition into the directory.

613363.title: Bed and Breakfast
613363.description:
AAA classifies a Bed and Breakfast as a limited service lodging type with the following definition;

"Usually smaller establishments emphasizing a more personal relationship between operators and guests, leading to an "at home" feeling. Guest units tend to be individually decorated. Rooms may not include some modern amenities such as television and telephones, and may have a shared bathroom. Usually owner-operated, with a common room or parlor, separate from the innkeeper's living quarters, where guests and operators can interact during evening and breakfast hours. Evening office closures are normal. A continental or full, hot breakfast is served and is included in the room rate."

(Quoted from the AAA. "New York TourBook". Buffalo, NY: AAA Publishing. 1999)

616863.title: Bed and Breakfast
616863.description:
AAA classifies a Bed and Breakfast as a limited service lodging type with the following definition;

"Usually smaller establishments emphasizing a more personal relationship between operators and guests, leading to an "at home" feeling. Guest units tend to be individually decorated. Rooms may not include some modern amenities such as television and telephones, and may have a shared bathroom. Usually owner-operated, with a common room or parlor, separate from the innkeeper's living quarters, where guests and operators can interact during evening and breakfast hours. Evening office closures are normal. A continental or full, hot breakfast is served and is included in the room rate."

(Quoted from the AAA. "New York TourBook". Buffalo, NY: AAA Publishing. 1999)

616916.title: Bed and Breakfast
616916.description:
AAA classifies a Bed and Breakfast as a limited service lodging type with the following definition;

"Usually smaller establishments emphasizing a more personal relationship between operators and guests, leading to an "at home" feeling. Guest units tend to be individually decorated. Rooms may not include some modern amenities such as television and telephones, and may have a shared bathroom. Usually owner-operated, with a common room or parlor, separate from the innkeeper's living quarters, where guests and operators can interact during evening and breakfast hours. Evening office closures are normal. A continental or full, hot breakfast is served and is included in the room rate."

(Quoted from the AAA. "New York TourBook". Buffalo, NY: AAA Publishing. 1999)

617992.description:
AAA classifies a Bed and Breakfast as a limited service lodging type with the following definition;

"Usually smaller establishments emphasizing a more personal relationship between operators and guests, leading to an "at home" feeling. Guest units tend to be individually decorated. Rooms may not include some modern amenities such as television and telephones, and may have a shared bathroom. Usually owner-operated, with a common room or parlor, separate from the innkeeper's living quarters, where guests and operators can interact during evening and breakfast hours. Evening office closures are normal. A continental or full, hot breakfast is served and is included in the room rate."

(Quoted from the AAA. "New York TourBook". Buffalo, NY: AAA Publishing. 1999)

617901.title: Bed and Breakfast
617901.description:
AAA classifies a Bed and Breakfast as a limited service lodging type with the following definition;

"Usually smaller establishments emphasizing a more personal relationship between operators and guests, leading to an "at home" feeling. Guest units tend to be individually decorated. Rooms may not include some modern amenities such as television and telephones, and may have a shared bathroom. Usually owner-operated, with a common room or parlor, separate from the innkeeper's living quarters, where guests and operators can interact during evening and breakfast hours. Evening office closures are normal. A continental or full, hot breakfast is served and is included in the room rate."

(Quoted from the AAA. "New York TourBook". Buffalo, NY: AAA Publishing. 1999)
